text: min_p removes candidates whose probability is below min_p times the most probable token probability. top_p instead filters by cumulative probability mass. min_tokens_to_keep protects a minimum number of the highest-probability candidates from min_p filtering and must be a positive integer. text: For tokens in its selected context, repetition_penalty multiplies negative logits by the penalty and divides nonnegative logits by the penalty. presence_penalty subtracts its penalty once for a token present in context, while frequency_penalty subtracts a penalty scaled by that token's occurrence count.
